content: In these sprawling regions, the demand level for automotive air-conditioning services is classified as low to medium, primarily due to lower population densities and correspondingly lower vehicle ownership rates. Service penetration is concurrently low, resulting in a market status that is also considered underserved. While approximately 53.7 percent of fleets currently implement structured, scheduled maintenance programs, a significant portion of the sector continues to lag in digital transformation, with 30.8 percent still relying on rudimentary tools like spreadsheets for daily operations [54] . The movement away from rigid ownership structures toward flexible, outsourced, and technologically integrated fleet management models is a structural shift rather than a temporary market adjustment. As organizations navigate the multifaceted complexities of modern construction projects, the integration of specialized outsourcing partners will remain a primary driver of efficiency, scalability, and competitive advantage in the global landscape [64][65] .
